reason: Equivalent (GUARD_OFF, `if TYPE_CHECKING:` to `if False:`). typing.TYPE_CHECKING is the constant False at runtime, so the original and the mutant both skip the block on every import; the block's only content is the `from homeassistant.core import HomeAssistant` that the module's annotations name, and under `from __future__ import annotations` no annotation is evaluated, so no reader can observe the difference.
